newsitem.title: USA: Telebras rises in New York.
newsitem.headline: Telebras rises in New York.

text.p: Brazilian telephone holding Telebras SA rose in early trade Wednesday, and traders said it likely had been oversold amid turmoil over Asian currencies.
American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) in the company rose 1-1/46 to 135-7/8 in heavy volume. The ADRs were among the most active issues on the New York Stock Exchange.
Telebras, a bellwether Brazilian stock, fell 11-1/4 Tuesday. Brazilian shares have been roiled by jitters that Brazil would devalue its currency in spillover from turmoil hitting Asian currencies.
"It probably was oversold yesterday. Basically there is no fundamental change in Latin America," said Lucia Skwarek, head of Latin American equities at UBS Securiities.
ING Barings upgraded its rating for Telebras to buy from hold, citing price weakness.
